definitionZh: 位置- try-falls CSS 属性使您能够指定一个或多个替代位置的列表,尝试对锁定位置的元素进行相对于其关联锚要素的置放的倒置选项. 当元素否则会溢出其嵌入式修改后包含的块时,浏览器会尝试按照所提供的顺序将定位元素置于这些不同的倒置位置,直到找到一个值来阻止其溢出容器或景点.
sourceDefinition: The position-try-fallbacks CSS property enables you to specify a list of one or more alternative position try fallback options for anchor-positioned elements to be placed relative to their associated anchor elements. When the element would otherwise overflow its inset-modified containing block, the browser will try placing the positioned element in these different fallback positions, in the order provided, until it finds a value that stops it from overflowing its container or the viewport.
